title: Pending Publish layout editor panel pruning
summary: Prune secondary Pending Publish evidence panels from the Layout Editor panel list while leaving their page content rendered.
reason: The Pending Publish page has many read-only evidence/detail panels, so the Layout Editor drawer looked like it had far more customizable boxes than the operator-facing page layout should expose.
behavior_before: Opening the Layout Editor on Pending Publish listed every direct Pending Publish panel, including secondary drain evidence, inventory, history, and advanced proof strips.
behavior_after: Pending Publish can mark auxiliary panels as layout-editor excluded, and the Layout Editor skips those panels for keys, customization bars, ordering, and drawer rows.
manual_validation: In-app Browser on local API 127.0.0.1:8765 - Pending Publish Layout Editor rowCount=10; excluded panels had no data-panel-key; advanced excluded panels retained data-advanced
rollback_plan: Revert the Pending Publish layout-editor exclusion attributes, the layout manager exclusion filter, and the targeted layout-manager smoke coverage.
notes:
WebView layout editor display change only. No backend route, media policy, queue, publish/drain, rename, settings save, or filesystem mutation behavior changes.
Pending Publish Layout Editor now skips auxiliary panels via data-layout-editor-exclude while preserving advanced-gate visibility.
Bundled Python did not have pytest installed, so targeted Python checks were run with unittest and PYTHONPATH=src.
